Loads declarative rules (embedded defaults, optional project override at

docs/process/_internal/process_hygiene_rules.yaml, or --rules-file) and reports

matches. Does not modify objects. Reusable from scheduler jobs, callbacks, and

other tools via pkg/processhygiene.



Rule schema: version + rules[].id, description, match.field, and exactly one of

prefix, suffix, equals, regex. Extend by editing the YAML or adding new rules.

  JSON report using embedded defaults or project internal rules file
  zqk.test system object-hygiene-scan --format json
  Custom rule file and coordinator notification
  zqk.test system object-hygiene-scan --format json --rules-file ./my-rules.yaml --emit-events

Usage:
  zqk.test system object-hygiene-scan [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --emit-events             When set and findings > 0, emit a coordinator operational event (best-effort)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --rules-file string       Path to a YAML rule file (overrides project internal default)
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
